name: PicS N.V.
summary: PicS N.V., a subsidiary of Jf International B.v. and formerly known as Picpay Holdings Netherlands B.V., is a prominent digital financial services provider based in São Paulo, Brazil. Established in 2012, the company offers a comprehensive digital wallet and mobile application designed for both individual consumers and businesses. For its individual users, PicS N.V. facilitates a wide array of transactional services. These include instant payments via Brazil's Pix system, peer-to-peer transfers within the PicPay ecosystem, convenient bill payment options, payroll portability, and even a global account feature. Furthermore, a dedicated payment assistant helps users consolidate, organize, and settle their various bills through a centralized hub. Beyond payments, PicS N.V. extends its financial product suite to include versatile multipurpose cards and a variety of lending solutions. These encompass personal loans, installment payment options, and specialized payroll loans tailored for public servants, retirees, pensioners, and formally employed workers. It also grants access to the FGTS annual birthday withdrawal program. The company further operates a digital insurance platform, distributing products like digital wallet insurance, PicPay Card bill protection, credit life insurance, smartphone protection, life insurance, and home insurance. Additionally, it caters to diverse investor profiles and financial objectives with a selection of investment products. For small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs), PicS N.V. provides a robust portfolio of services, including QR Code payment solutions, comprehensive banking services, and corporate benefits with salary advance options. The company also operates PicPay Shop, an integrated marketplace where consumers can purchase a variety of products and services, and PicPay Ads, an advertising platform that enables brands to engage with its active user base through contextually relevant placements within the application.
